name: outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.State.mk.noConfusion
type_text:
{q : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.SerialRaw} →
  {P : Sort u} →
    {seed : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K} →
      {iteration : ℕ} →
        {x previous g selected sum first : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d} →
          {component sample : ℕ} →
            {phase : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.Phase} →
              {seed' : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K} →
                {iteration' : ℕ} →
                  {x' previous' g' selected' sum' first' : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d} →
                    {component' sample' : ℕ} →
                      {phase' : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.Phase} →
                        { seed := seed, iteration := iteration, x := x, previous := previous, g := g,
                              selected := selected, sum := sum, first := first, component := component,
                              sample := sample, phase := phase } =
                            { seed := seed', iteration := iteration', x := x', previous := previous', g := g',
                              selected := selected', sum := sum', first := first', component := component',
                              sample := sample', phase := phase' } →
                          (seed ≍ seed' →
                              iteration = iteration' →
                                x ≍ x' →
                                  previous ≍ previous' →
                                    g ≍ g' →
                                      selected ≍ selected' →
                                        sum ≍ sum' →
                                          first ≍ first' →
                                            component = component' → sample = sample' → phase = phase' → P) →
                            P
